channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: ‘Love the Symphony’ features soloist Elizabeth Winstead
item.description: Barton College/Wilson Symphony’s 34th annual “Love the Symphony” Valentine’s benefit on Feb. 14 features soprano Elizabeth Winstead, wine reception and candlelight buffet; tickets $100 with reservations.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 31-Feb. 1, 2026
item.description: Weekend area sports calendar: Barton men’s volleyball plays at Roosevelt (Illinois) on Saturday, followed by Barton softball at Anderson in a Sunday doubleheader.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL ROUNDUP: Darden boys clinch county title
item.description: Darden Middle boys clinched the Wilson County TAC division title, Forest Hills stayed in the playoff hunt, and Community Christian’s girls improved to 11-1 with back-to-back wins.

item.title: Scrappy Ladybirds hand Demons another loss
item.description: Southern Nash’s scrappy Ladybirds overpowered Fike 51-31 with pressure defense and rebounding, improving to 12-8 and 6-3 in Big East play as Croll, Hinnant and Richardson combined for 40 points.

item.title: Demons overwhelm struggling Firebirds
item.description: Fike crushed short-handed Southern Nash 84-29, climbing into a Big East tie for second at 7-2 and matching last season’s 16 wins as the Firebirds’ skid stretched to nine.

item.title: Wilson Prep girls swat WashCo to strengthen ECAC lead
item.description: Top-ranked Wilson Prep girls crushed Washington County 96-55 for their 15th straight win, moving to 6-0 in ECAC play behind Chloe Murphy's 27 points and a Paris Best triple-double.

item.title: Top-ranked Knights stifle No. 4 Harrells Christian for Salter’s 700th win
item.description: Top-ranked Greenfield locked down No. 4 Harrells Christian 64-47 as Kobe Edwards led a balanced attack, giving coach Salter his 700th win and underscoring the Knights’ status as NCISAA 2-A team to beat.

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Jan. 31, 2026
item.description: NCHSAA Basketball Glance: Updated boys and girls standings, recent scores and Tuesday’s matchups across Big East, Eastern Plains, ECAC and Three Rivers conferences.

item.title: Mayor rebukes councilman over confrontation with resident
item.description: Wilson Mayor Carlton Stevens sent an email to Wilson City Council members reminding them the scope of their authority after a recorded confrontation between newly-elected Councilman Lenwood Ward and a Wilson resident escalated into a police call.

item.title: Ice storm reshuffles NCHSAA swimming postseason
item.description: Ice storm wiped out NCHSAA swimming regionals, sending area standouts straight to next week’s state meets at Triangle Aquatic Center based on entry times and seeds.
